name: Ystra
hail: We heard. We do not know who you are. How many of you are you?
Many-Alone, we are Ystra. We are many, and we are one. Which of you is listening?
We have joined to answer. It is slow. You are so many, and each one apart.
close: The colony turns inward again. We are enough.
finding: We have worked this out, together: {part}
{part} All of us agree on it.
Passed body to body until it was sure: {part}
{part} No one body found it. We found it.
The colonies have settled on this: {part}
sighting: {part} The watching bodies passed it inward.
From the edge of the colony, where we watch: {part}
We noticed this, though it is outside us: {part}
{part} We looked, together, and agreed on what we saw.
archive: From what all of us hold: {part}
{part} It was kept by many, so it is kept well.
We share this, as a colony shares scent: {part}
{part} No one body holds it. All of us do.
Carried in from the deep colonies: {part}
culture: {part} You may find it strange. We find you strange.
We are not one, and not many. {part}
{part} We say it with one voice, made of many.
About us, which is all of us: {part}
request: {part} Answer together, if you can. One voice is hard for us to hear.
We have touched on this, and wish to know more: {part}
verdict: {part} No one body chose this. We did.
{part} It is the whole of us that says it.
We turned it among ourselves until it was one thing: {part}
accord: Between us and all of you: {part}
{part} Tell every one of you, since you are each apart.
All of us, to all of you: {part}
{part} We hold it as one. Can you?
